name: NB Eazy Addons For Elementor
author: Nashir Uddin

sections.description:
Eazy Addons For Elementor is a lightweight, extendable Elementor widget extension plugin that enhances your page builder experience with handcrafted widgets including:

Free Widgets List

  1. Countdown Timer: Add countdown timer.
  2. Post Carousel: Add post carousel.
  3. Accordion: Add accordion
  4. Advanced Heading: Add advanced heading.
  5. Callout Section: Add callout box.
  6. Content Toggle: Show/hide items on toggle.
  7. Feature Box: Add feature box
  8. Image Gallery: Add Image gallery
  9. Post Grid: Add post grid.
  10. Pricing Table: Add pricing table.
  11. Progress Bar: Showcase progressive information.
  12. Service List: Add service list.
  13. Testimonials: Add testimonials.
  14. Content Card: Showcase products, articles, news.
  15. Image Comparision: Showcase before/after images.
  16. Icon Box: Show info in iconic style.
  17. Review: Add feedback, reviews, & ratings.
  18. Info Box: Create information boxes.
  19. Gradient Heading: Add gradient to headlines.
  20. Team Member: Showcase team members.
  21. Dual Button: Add two buttons within one container.
  22. Number: Add number blocks.
  23. Logo Grid: Display logos in grid.
  24. Justified Grid: Add isotope gallery.
  25. Slider: Add sliders with animationss.
  26. Step Flow: Create Step-by-step visual diagram & instructions.
  27. Fun-Factor/Counter: Create fun counter widget.
  28. Calendlyr: Integrate Calendly in site.
  29. News Ticker: Show content like news websites.
  30. Social Icon: Add social icon with links.

All widgets are fully responsive, styleable via Elementor, and follow WordPress development standards.

License

Eazy Addons For Elementor is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/eazy-addons-for-elementor directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Open any page with Elementor and start using the Eazy Addons For Elementor widgets under the “Eazy Addons For Elementor” section.
sections.faq:
Does this require Elementor Pro?

No. It works with the free version of Elementor.

Will this slow down my site?

No. Assets are only loaded when needed by the widgets you use.

Can I disable widgets I don’t use?

This feature will be added in a future version.
